final: SELECT a.City, a.AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM flights f JOIN airports a ON TRIM(f.SourceAirport) = a.AirportCode GROUP BY a.City, a.AirportCode HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(source_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM flights GROUP BY TRIM(SourceAirport))) ORDER BY a.City, a.AirportCode
